decision.headline: Launch A: it wins by 27.7 points and is 100% likely to be the better version.
reasons: A wins on intent to visit: 70.2% vs 42.5%, a 27.7-point gap with a 95% interval of ±19.3 points, and A is ahead in 1 of 1 seeds. A is 100% likely to be the better version.
A live split test would need about 50 people per version (0.4% of the local Instagram users) and paid impressions to detect this gap. Ripple ran it on the simulated crowd for $0 of ad spend.
There are about 23,020 Instagram users in Short North, Columbus, OH 43201 (Census x Pew join).

plan.success_metric: Taps through to the post and store visits attributed to the post (the real-world counterpart of the simulated intent to visit).
plan.decision_rule: Keep version A running if its tap rate is not below the simulated range; otherwise pause it.
plan.stop_rule: Stop after 2,302 people have seen it, or after 7 days.
